component.name: frostylauncher
component.summary: Install and launch Blizzard games on Linux

description.p: frostylauncher is a reliable, idempotent way to run Blizzard games (World of Warcraft, Diablo, Overwatch, Hearthstone and more) on Linux. It drives umu-launcher together with a Proton build and manages a dedicated Wine prefix, with logging, health checks and self-healing.
